purpose: Classify the common actor terrain/collision pass and identify the source and Level 01 locations of interaction state 0x46.

static_decompilation.loop: Iterates 30 non-player actor records at 0x00FF7E82 with stride 0x42. For collision-enabled actors with a nonzero frame pointer, nonnegative vertical motion, and a valid terrain row, it clears actor +0x3D and probes the current, above, and below terrain records.
static_decompilation.state_write: When a sampled terrain class is nonzero, actor +0x3D receives resource_byte_2 at the same resource index. If actor flags +0x3C bit 0x10 are clear, vertical motion +0x1A is cleared; otherwise the actor is vertically aligned and a terrain effect may be queued.
static_decompilation.invalid_or_empty_path: Out-of-range rows set actor flags +0x06 bit 0x40 and clear bit 0x01. If all three sampled terrain classes are empty, the actor receives a downward motion adjustment unless actor flags +0x06 bit 0x80 are set.

cleanup_neighbors.0x001AE30A: Actor_InitializeFromTemplate clears actor +0x3D during record initialization.
cleanup_neighbors.0x001AE368: Actor_ClearInteractionState clears actor +0x3D during owned-resource cleanup.

behavior_0x46_cells.world_y_model: map row * 16 + 240; the two bands are approximately world Y 896 and 928

level01_resource_correlation.class_table_check: The behavior-0x46 records have resource_byte_0=0x01. The 0x2FD2 row at 0x2FE2 contains 0x81, so the low six bits are nonzero for every x-cell and the actor state write is eligible when the three-probe conditions are met.

relationship_to_upper_pair.result: The explicit upper-frontier left/up replay reaches ordinary Type-0x1E state but has no state-0x46 observation. This is consistent with the static map: the tested pair is not in either Level 01 behavior-0x46 band.
relationship_to_upper_pair.extended_stream_condition: The movement stream at 0x0012046C compares actor +0x3D against 0x46; the comparison is a terrain-contact condition, not a scene transition selector.

conclusion: The only writer of actor interaction state +0x3D in the examined common pass is the decoded terrain resource's third byte. State 0x46 is produced by terrain behavior records and is cleared on initialization/cleanup. Level 01 contains 23 static behavior-0x46 cells in two lower bands, while the tested upper Type-0x1E route contains none. The upper extended branch remains unobserved, but its prerequisite is now localized to a finite lower-band terrain/contact route rather than an unknown actor-side flag producer. No scene-state, scene-countdown, or player-coordinate write occurs in this producer pass.
next_action: Use the Level 01 behavior-0x46 bands to choose a targeted lower-route checkpoint and trace whether a Type-0x1E actor can occupy those cells and reach 0x0012046C; retain the existing upper-frontier negative as separate coverage.
